Acorn PMH-T-02, Machiavelli Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull

Simply changing the hardware on cabinets, on dressers, or on accordion closet doors can transform a space into into something that feels totally new. The Stainless Steel Machiavelli Cabinet Pull has a beautiful shape that will look great in traditional and modern decors. It has a brushed stainless steel finish. It comes with all the necessary installation hardware. The Machiavelli cabinet pull has a 4 inch center to center.

Also Available Matching Machiavelli Cabinet Knob

Specifications of the Machiavelli Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Center to Center: 4"
  • Overall Length: 5-5/8"
  • Height: 11/16"
  • Projection: 3/4"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
